title: A TRANSIENT capacity condition on the compose lane is converted into a PERMANENT-LOOKING capability verdict, plus a spur
description: A TRANSIENT capacity condition on the compose lane is converted into a PERMANENT-LOOKING capability verdict, plus a spurious capability gap. The cascade, in goal-hosts own words: EARLY EDIT-INTENT DETECTED (pre-walk, names repos/<vessel>/src/<file>) — routing to feature_compose; then EARLY EDIT-INTENT feature_compose verdict=BUSY — falling through to walk; then the walk infers a target shape and the dispatch is evicted with reach graded false: no template produces the inferred target shapes [fs_edit]; capability gap filed by the walk. The fallback is the defect. The walk CANNOT serve an edit goal at all, because every shape target inference produces for this class has no producer: fs_edit, fileEditResult and code_modification_proposal are all named in live evictions and none is producible. So when compose is free the goal becomes a route-edit gap and progresses through gap-compose, and when compose is busy the identical goal is graded a capability failure and files a capability gap naming a shape that is not the real problem. Measured 2026-08-23 across seven operator dispatches of the same class: those that reached compose became route-edit gaps (route-edit-c2f83378, route-edit-ca73164a, route-edit-4ad6a328) and were refused by real gates with actionable lessons; the two that hit BUSY fell through and died as no-trace with inferred targets code_modification_proposal and fs_edit respectively. Rewording the goal changed WHICH dead shape was inferred (removing the word proposal moved it from code_modification_proposal to fs_edit) but not the outcome, so goal wording steers target inference between unproducible shapes. Consequences: the same goal succeeds or fails on lane timing rather than on merit; the honest reason (lane saturated, retry) is replaced by a misleading one (no producer for this shape); and the walk mints capability gaps for shapes that are not the actual gap, inflating the gap store with phantom demand. Fix: on EDIT-INTENT with a compose BUSY or draining verdict, refuse with a retryable capacity reason instead of falling through to a walk that structurally cannot serve the class, and do not file a capability gap from that path. Edit site repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts near the EARLY EDIT-INTENT handling around line 11614. Related: gap-edit-intent-compose-lane-lands-nothing lists the capacity refusals and the target-inference failures as separate symptoms; this is the link between them.
